- Strong latency focus: p95 end-to-end <150ms (NA), aim <200ms (EU) for streaming chat responses.

- Regional routing & fallback: require NA/EU routing with automatic fallback to alternate region/model variant (degraded but available) — uptime & graceful degradation are top of the list.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget; willing to trade some latency for predictable unit economics. Interested in Optimize recommendations (batching, quantization).

Security/compliance notes:
- Corporate policy requires SSO (SAML), audit logs for all inference calls, KMS integration for keys, and final legal signoff for EU data residency.
- Currently on AWS with VPC peering for internal APIs; wants optional VPC connectivity for Dedicated.
